items.title: What a year this has been
items.text: What a year this has been! Time to reflect and do a blog post over the holidays. OC is in a great place, we found a niche in prosumer and enterprise adoption. The multiplayer team feature is best in class. Shipping reliable and free open source is also really really hard, and waking up to countless user complaints every day is an emotional challenge. I’m glad the team is taking over most of the work these days. We mostly been focussing on the boring part of ensuring things are fast, reliable and secure, with the exception of the new memory system and soon OpenClaw ID. To many more years!

items.text: I've been using Gemini 4 Neon and @antigravity all weekend and made a free video course on how you can get the most out of this combo. Some takeaways: 1. Orchestrator and /swarm are very useful for planning and building with multiple agents. At one point, I had 42 agents running at once. 2. /grill-me is a great built-in skill that gets Antigravity to ask clarifying questions to help you flesh out the plan first. 3. Remote control is better than Claude Code's because every thread is active by default. I show you how to add Antigravity to your phone home screen to run this in the video. 📌 Watch my full 17-minute Antigravity course here: https://t.co/lmfSTiVBsm

But then there’s a lag between these new tools and users figuring out what to do with them.

items.title: America can build the best frontier models and still lose the global AI race
items.text: America can build the best frontier models and still lose the global AI race. Which is why Jensen’s return matters far beyond Nvidia. Governments around the world want sovereign AI: models they can run on their own soil, on their own infrastructure, under their own control. If American companies won’t meet that demand, Chinese companies will. Countries will start with Chinese models, then adopt Chinese infrastructure and chips. Having the smartest model won’t mean much if most of the world runs on someone else’s stack. We’ve seen a version of this play out with Huawei.
